title: The multi-depot vehicle routing problem with profit fairness
license_or_reuse: publisher copyright; method may be independently reimplemented but article text/code may not be copied
verified_detail: Full PDF SHA256 07bf3ac92303eab0b7d9e713606334b1db262097692eeedce6942056392544e2; Eq. 11 is P_d >= P_hat*P_d0; Section 4.3 uses a fairness-modified insertion score and only fairness-feasible local moves
applicability_to_e3_e6: Directly matches E6 participation ratio and proves fairness can guide reconstruction inside ALNS
limitation: No author source code located; homogeneous fleet and simpler route physics than ReSETP

title: Inter-depot moves and dynamic-radius search for multi-depot vehicle routing problems
authors_year: Gauthier and Irnich (2022 technical report; repository item 2024)
verified_detail: Local PDF SHA256 30206febc6d919a957e23e038b209fbe0718d8d75d04b11d88c6d2de947868db; formalizes inter-depot 2-opt and 2-opt-star with corrected radius pruning and also discusses relocate, swap, Or-opt, and string exchange
applicability_to_e3_e6: Strong source for efficient cross-depot local-search neighborhoods in E3
limitation: Authors report better average local optima did not improve the final ILS best; no code located

title: Cyclic Transfer Algorithm for Multivehicle Routing and Scheduling Problems
verified_detail: Introduces negative-cost cyclic transfers that jointly alter assignment to vehicles and within-route sequencing
applicability_to_e3_e6: Foundational support for multi-customer responsibility-transfer chains
limitation: Old general framework; no directly reusable implementation located

title: Multiple neighborhood search, tabu search and ejection chains for the multi-depot open vehicle routing problem
verified_detail: Uses a uniform ejection-chain view across neighborhoods inside MNS-TS for a multi-depot problem
applicability_to_e3_e6: Supports a multi-step cross-depot chain rather than isolated one-customer moves
limitation: Open routes do not return to depots; no author code or permissive software license located

title: A new exact algorithm for the multi-depot vehicle routing problem under capacity and route length constraints
verified_detail: Uses vehicle-flow and set-partitioning formulations plus pricing and valid inequalities
applicability_to_e3_e6: Supports a route-column master where depot and member attributes can be explicit
limitation: Exact branch-price-cut machinery is too large to transplant as an ALNS operator

title: A multi-space sampling heuristic for the green vehicle routing problem
verified_detail: Builds a route pool and assembles solutions with set partitioning; reports pool-quality dependence and strong benchmark results
applicability_to_e3_e6: Supports using an ALNS-generated feasible route pool followed by a restricted master
limitation: Single-depot green VRP; no verified open implementation and no participant-fairness constraint

title: On an Integer Program for a Delivery Problem
verified_detail: Classical integer-programming foundation for route-selection/set-partitioning delivery formulations
applicability_to_e3_e6: Foundational support for exact assembly from feasible route columns
limitation: Not an implementation and predates rich VRP constraints

title: PyVRP: a high-performance VRP solver package
verified_detail: Pinned v0.13.4 commit 18815548d04a90a0e5eea2a0bed53a81ea9d2d49; supports multiple depots; C++ Exchange, SwapTails, and SwapStar have tests
applicability_to_e3_e6: Best permissively licensed source for high-performance route-tail and free-reinsertion exchange patterns
limitation: Does not implement ReSETP energy, charging, physical multitrip, or member-profit constraints

title: PyVRP 0.13.4 search methods
license_or_reuse: MIT code; documentation reuse terms not separately relied on
verified_detail: Documents SwapStar as free-form reinsertions and exposes route operators
applicability_to_e3_e6: Clarifies operator semantics before any clean-room adaptation
limitation: Documentation alone is not performance evidence on ReSETP

title: Hybrid Genetic Search for the CVRP: open-source implementation and SWAP-star neighborhood
verified_detail: Official implementation and paper DOI 10.1016/j.cor.2021.105643; license SHA256 f394ca7994e08f3e965d2041a36803d400b3cd3d2c2dc5c0a394fe1c28a7ef6c
applicability_to_e3_e6: Independent source for real SWAP-star rather than the repository's historical swapstar-lite label
limitation: Specialized to CVRP; current public HGS code is not a drop-in rich multi-depot EV solver

title: ALNS Python framework
applicability_to_e3_e6: Can support isolated operator-selection prototypes if approved
limitation: Framework supplies infrastructure rather than a collaboration/fairness algorithm

title: Current depot profit accounting
verified_detail: Revenue and all route costs are allocated to the serving route home depot; cross-site cost uses frozen customer owner
applicability_to_e3_e6: Defines the exact profit delta a fairness-guided operator must respect
limitation: Carbon quota allocation is not route-additive when quota is nonzero

title: Current candidate evaluation and fairness checker
verified_detail: Candidate objective adds one BIG_M per hard violation; fairness magnitude is not represented in the penalty
applicability_to_e3_e6: Proves fairness already enters candidate evaluation but only as a coarse hard gate
limitation: A one-yuan and a large member deficit receive the same per-depot BIG_M count

title: Current E6 formal runner
verified_detail: Fairness-on and fairness-off cooperative arms share the same start and reciprocal cross-depot neighborhood; theta and independent profits are wired into search
applicability_to_e3_e6: Provides the future adapter points and paired-ablation baseline
limitation: Historical E6 candidate reuse creates inference limits and must not be used as a new performance claim
